purpose: Frozen retrospective test of whether verified regional realized wheat-season weather explains Mandan yield beyond observed spring profile water
exposure: Mandan eligibility and prior model outcomes are exposed; this is a historical exploratory ablation, not an untouched final test.
preprocessing: Ridge; StandardScaler is fitted on numeric predictors in training fold only. No imputation, target transform, clipping, tuning or feature selection.
weather_source: Verified season_weather.csv: one study-area proxy for all years, no annual field assignment. Season aggregates are inclusive wheat planting through harvest. Realized future weather is retrospective and unavailable at cover planting.
validation: Existing frozen leave-one-year-out folds 2009–2011. Same common cohort within each task and year; shared controls stay in year. Arm subtraction uses same-year held-out predictions.
metrics: Per year and pooled MAE/RMSE/signed bias; macro-year MAE; paired benefit/harm confusion, harmful cover choices, missed benefits, balanced accuracy, and control-balanced MAE. Baseline metrics included. No inferential claim from three overlapping years.
limitations: Regional weather proxy, not annual plot weather
Observed spring water and realized season weather are retrospective; unavailable at earlier planting decision
Spring water is 0–210 cm stored water, not PAW
No exact soil sampling dates inferred
No serving refit, promotion, API payload or Colorado changes
